test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are five friends U, V, W, X and Y, sitting in a row facing North. U is to the left of V and W is to the right of X. X is sitting in the right of Y and he is the second from the left. Who is the first from the right?
solution: According to the given information: 1) U is to the left of V and W is to the right of X. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8df927e10fedca81be00ad821ddc80cf7eed56fcaf379f363033c4c578117324.png]
